title: VVaporesso DOJO Blast Pod & Refill For 10K or 30K Device – Kiwi Passion Fruit Guava
description: Please Note: Compatible with Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K & 30K Kits Only Refresh your Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K vape kit with the Kiwi Passion Fruit Guava Prefilled Pod & Refill Pack. This tropical refill pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and an 8ml refill container, both filled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid in a bold exotic fruit blend. Kiwi Passion Fruit Guava brings together the tangy bite of Kiwi, the fragrant sweetness of Passion Fruit, and the mellow, tropical flavour of Guava for a smooth yet vibrant vape that’s bursting with character. It's an ideal choice for vapers who enjoy layered tropical profiles with a sweet and juicy finish. Each pod and refill pack is designed exclusively for the Dojo Blast 10K device and offers up to 10,000 puffs (device total), powered by Vaporesso's dual mesh coil and COREX 2.0 technology. The transparent pod design makes it easy to track your e-liquid levels, while the Smart Liq-Cycle system ensures steady coil saturation for consistently excellent flavour.
